title: Rivals
summary: Navigate rival adventurers and decide how to handle the wounded Silverclaw.
overview: Navigate rival adventurers and decide how to handle the wounded Silverclaw.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Decide on the intended faction objective before promising to help Silverclaw.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The assigned task selects the Norrath's Keepers or Dark Reign rival party.
Moving through the meeting area advances the negotiation and starts attacks from the local goblins and spiders.
Silverclaw begins at half health. Promising not to harm him makes him protected and opens the recovery dialogue.
Returning the stolen tooth spawns a chest and ends the expedition, but explicitly fails the assigned task and suppresses normal completion rewards for players inside.

notes: Approval E356. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The alternate tooth-return ending updates a task stage while announcing failure and suppressing in-zone rewards; verify intended reward behavior before publication.
